sections.text:

full_text:
Tables

Introduction. Tables are furniture. They can be used for placing items on top or as simple decorative objects.

Common properties. Tables provide comfort, but they do not stack with each other: only the highest-comfort table in a player's vicinity will provide comfort.
All tables have the following damage resistances:
• Weak: Chop
• Neutral: Blunt, Slash, Pickaxe, Fire, Frost, Lightning
• Resistant: Pierce
• Immune: Poison, Spirit
